<div class="card-body">
'''Mantellian Savrip''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="photo">[https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/star-wars-ccg-japanese-premiere/imagegallery/29544 Japanese Premiere collector gallery], PSA; [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/160356883/CILd1m1vXki3ieTeUdMwBA.jpg Mantellian Savrip original photograph].</ref>

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">マンテリアン・サヴリップ</span><ref name="photo" />

<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">3フォース消費して、場の自分の側に配備する（C－3POが場にでていれば、配備コスト0）。戦闘に負けた際、手札からキャラクター、宇宙船、ビークルのカードを、カードの没収値の値で没収して、戦闘ダメージや、損耗値を減らすことができる。</span><ref name="photo" />

<h2>Lore</h2>
<span lang="ja">デジャリックとは、銀河中の猛獣や、伝説上の怪物のホログラムを使って遊ぶゲームである。マンテリアン・サヴリップは、オード・マンテルの獰猛な肉食獣である。</span><ref name="photo" />

<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Mantellian Savrip.<ref name="photo" />

'''Card text:''' Use 3 Force to deploy on your side of the table (deployment costs 0 if [[C-3PO (See-Threepio)|C-3PO]] is on the table). When you lose a battle, you may forfeit character, starship, and vehicle cards from your hand for their forfeit values to reduce battle damage or attrition.<ref name="photo" />

'''Lore:''' Dejarik is a game played using holograms of fierce beasts and legendary monsters from throughout the galaxy. The Mantellian savrip is a ferocious carnivore from Ord Mantell.<ref name="photo" />

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The deployment cost, [[C-3PO (See-Threepio)|C-3PO]] exception, and forfeiting from hand after losing a battle are retained. The Japanese lore describes a ferocious carnivore and does not include the English adjective “hulking.”<ref name="photo" /><ref name="english-face">[https://cdn4.volusion.store/zybxa-zvknq/v/vspfiles/photos/12631-2T.jpg?v-cache=1776549977 Mantellian Savrip English printed photograph], [https://www.swccgstore.com/Star-Wars-CCG-Mantellian-Savrip-p/12631.htm SWCCGStore].</ref>
